sources.title: Tembo agents
sources.finding: Per-agent harness/model defaults and scheduled/integration/webhook dispatch with an API key are documented. 201 means queued, not completed.

sources.title: Tembo models
sources.finding: Own API credentials, ChatGPT, personal Claude and SuperGrok subscription routes differ; connected accounts must belong to the user. Compute remains billable.

sources.title: Tembo sandbox
sources.finding: Dedicated Linux VM per session; teardown does not remove prepared project caches. Provider retention is separate.

sources.title: Tembo self-hosted
sources.finding: Licensed NixOS image includes web/API/workers/cron/database stack. Operator manages networking/secrets/backups; Kubernetes/GCP early access.

sources.title: Tembo connected-device CLI
sources.finding: Gradual Devices rollout connects a user machine. Only human-started sessions of its owner use it; commands run with user permissions.

sources.title: Tembo MCP connections
sources.finding: Custom local/remote MCP servers with OAuth or other credentials can be personal or workspace-shared; calls reach the selected external service.

sources.title: Tembo rule files
sources.finding: Reads the first supported repository rule file before every session; architecture/testing text is guidance, not a proved gate.

sources.title: Tembo prepared projects
sources.finding: Projects cache repositories, dependencies and running services in disk/memory environments by size. Daily refresh and build pinning are documented.

sources.title: Tembo pull requests
sources.finding: Normally opens linked PRs per repository; dashboard sessions show Changes and wait for explicit Open PR. Signed GitHub commits and PR templates are documented.

sources.title: Tembo agent actions
sources.finding: Connected integrations expose issue updates, PRs, documents and other actions through MCP. These are external records, not proof of native issue management.

sources.title: Tembo pricing
sources.finding: Current page offers seven-day Max trial, Pro $60 with $90 monthly usage and Max $200 with $400; compute is separately metered against allowances.

sources.title: Tembo changelog
sources.finding: Recent entries describe device screens, skill editor, visibility preferences, user Insights, in-session questions and retained image artifacts.

sources.title: Tembo Installation; Supported browsers
sources.finding: Tembo PWA installs from app.tembo.io with Safari iOS and Chrome Android home-screen steps. Supported Safari minimum iOS 14.3. Push notifications are coming soon, not shipped.

sources.title: Tembo Available hooks; When setup runs; Failure handling
sources.locator: Available hooks; When setup runs; Failure handling
sources.finding: setupScript runs after fresh clone/before agent; restored project environments skip it until rebuilt. Commands run sequentially and failure logs but does not stop session. prePush is accepted/validated but not executed, so cannot gate pushes.

sources.title: Tembo Repository skills; Managed skills
sources.finding: Tembo loads repository, managed and built-in skills. Managed editor creates/edits/deletes skill folders and reference files and copies them to each agent skill directory. Managed skills apply across every workspace session; malformed frontmatter is skipped.

sources.title: Tembo MCP; Sessions/artifacts; CLI commands
sources.finding: Sandbox tools can list/discover/call MCP tools and create HTML/Markdown/CSV/JSON/uploaded artifacts. Sandbox CLI includes verified commit/push, preview service artifact, final response and VM keepalive. This is distinct from personal-device pairing CLI.

sources.title: Tembo Public API index; Agent instruction revisions; Artifacts
sources.locator: Public API index; Agent instruction revisions; Artifacts
sources.finding: Current API index lists agent/session/repository operations, run status/duration/error retrieval and artifact creation. Agent instructions have saved revisions and optimistic concurrency restore; revisions exclude other configuration. API describes queuing, not completed work.

sources.title: Tembo Allowance; Overages; Bursts; Monitoring
sources.finding: Trial stops at expiry/exhaustion; upgrade needed to continue. Pro/Max optional overage caps block new sessions after balance/cap, while started sessions may finish. Bursts queue to worker capacity without enqueue cap. Billing shows gateway/compute separately and seconds of actual VM time; BYOK/subscription inference costs zero through Tembo, compute still applies.

sources.title: Tembo Access controls; Compliance; Data handling
sources.finding: Vendor states SAML/OIDC, roles for admins/reviewers/operators, per-session audit and configurable retention/SIEM export. It reports SOC 2 Type II and ISO claims with reports under NDA but no issuer/period shown. Cloud repository mirrors persist in Git storage, while self-hosted clone stays inside network. Vendor states no training; cloud deletion requests honored within 30 days.

sources.title: Tembo Classes/pools; Scaling; Sessions
sources.finding: Self-hosted Kubernetes controller sizes agent-host pools by running/waiting memory and minIdleMemory up to maxHosts. Each session has own VM; same-host saved memory resumes processes, replacement-host disk restore loses processes. Idle host removal is coming, not shipped. Hosts failing registration after 15 minutes are replaced.
